before.requirement: When parsing finishes or a parser holding an orphan last_comment is freed, release that comment once without retaining a pointer to released storage.
before.reason: The terminal path releases an orphan without clearing last_comment, and parser destruction has no last_comment release. Reachability through this harness is unresolved.

after.requirement: When parsing finishes or a parser holding an orphan last_comment is freed, release that comment once and avoid a stale pointer during any subsequent cleanup.
after.reason: The terminal release clears last_comment, and parser destruction releases a remaining comment. The packet still does not establish a reachable orphan or whether the harness invokes destruction in that state.

claims.reason: Both versions are assessed against the same harness, which creates a zero-flag parser and returns without freeing it when get_error is non-null. Whether either path encounters the frozen orphan-comment condition is unknown.
missing_information: Before and after definitions of ucl_parser_add_string_priority, ucl_skip_comments, and ucl_attach_comment.
The UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS definition and all before and after assignments to parser->last_comment.
The before and after paths that can assign parser->last_comment are needed to establish whether a finite input creates an orphan under zero parser flags.
The before and after add-string call paths are needed to establish when parsing ends and whether an error leaves an orphan for cleanup.
